goal.title: Your goal

hint.lose: A target below your current weight.
hint.maintain: Eat what your body needs each day so your weight stays steady.
hint.gain: A target above your current weight. You eat a little above your daily needs.

goal.derivedGain: Your target is above your current weight, so JoyoRogo uses Gain weight mode.
goal.maintainNote: The target weight follows your current weight.
goal.maternalOff: Gain weight mode is off while you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

plan.intro: Your eating target = your body's base needs (BMR) plus a calorie surplus. Real activity is added on top. The surplus comes from the pace of gain your target date implies.

surplus.label: Surplus to gain weight
surplus.name: Extra food
surplus.body: Extra on top of BMR so your weight rises slowly. It is worked out from the gap to your target weight and your target date, kept between {{min}} and {{max}} kcal a day.

plan.pace: About {{kg}} kg a week ({{pct}}% of body weight)
plan.reach: At this pace you reach your target around {{date}}.
plan.protein: Protein {{min}} to {{max}} g a day. The target is {{target}} g.
plan.proteinHint: Enough protein, plus strength training, helps the extra weight become muscle rather than only fat.
plan.leanNote: Some of the extra weight is still fat. A slow pace and strength training make more of it muscle.
plan.estimate: One kg of body weight is counted as 7,700 kcal, a common approximation. Real results vary, so watch your weight trend for 2 to 3 weeks, then adjust.
plan.burnNote: The exercise you log is added to what you can still eat that day. If you train hard and your weight has not risen after 2 to 3 weeks, eat a little more.

today.overHint: That's fine, a bit more now and then is normal. Back to the target tomorrow.
today.tipShort: If it is hard to finish, split it into 5 or 6 small meals. Add rice, eggs, tempeh, or avocado.
today.tipOver: You are past your target. Relax, your body can use it.
today.ideasHint: Everyday food that is dense in calories and nutrients.
today.streak_one: {{count}} day in a row eating up to target
today.streak_other: {{count}} days in a row eating up to target
today.streakRule: A day counts when you eat at least 90% of your target.
today.cardSummary: Target {{target}} kcal a day: BMR {{tdee}} plus {{surplus}}.

date.hint: Pick the date and your surplus and daily eating target adjust with it.

ok.lean_one: Just right. Gain {{kg}} kg in {{count}} day, {{perWeek}} kg a week ({{pct}}% of body weight), easy and safe.
ok.lean_other: Just right. Gain {{kg}} kg in {{count}} days, {{perWeek}} kg a week ({{pct}}% of body weight), easy and safe.
ok.brisk_one: Fine. Gain {{kg}} kg in {{count}} day, {{perWeek}} kg a week ({{pct}}%). That is above the lean bulk range (0.25 to 0.5% a week), so more of it may be fat. Still reasonable for beginners or if you are underweight.
ok.brisk_other: Fine. Gain {{kg}} kg in {{count}} days, {{perWeek}} kg a week ({{pct}}%). That is above the lean bulk range (0.25 to 0.5% a week), so more of it may be fat. Still reasonable for beginners or if you are underweight.

fast.title: This date needs {{perWeek}} kg a week ({{pct}}% of body weight), which is too fast.
fast.titleSurplus: This date needs about +{{surplus}} kcal a day, above the {{max}} kcal limit.
fast.body_one: Above 1% of body weight a week, most of the gain turns into fat and your stomach may feel uncomfortable. Gaining {{kg}} kg at a gentler pace takes about {{count}} day.
fast.body_other: Above 1% of body weight a week, most of the gain turns into fat and your stomach may feel uncomfortable. Gaining {{kg}} kg at a gentler pace takes about {{count}} days.

slow.title: That date is quite far away.
slow.body: The pace is slow, so JoyoRogo still uses a surplus of at least {{surplus}} kcal a day. At that rate you reach your target around {{date}}.

preview.changed: Eating target becomes {{next}} kcal a day (now {{current}}), surplus +{{surplus}}.
preview.same: Eating target stays {{kcal}} kcal a day.

target.hint: Above your current weight, so the plan is to gain.
target.aboveHealthy: This target weight is above the healthy range ({{min}} to {{max}} kg). You can go ahead, but talk to a doctor or dietitian first.

notes.disclaimer: JoyoRogo is not a medical tool. The numbers are general estimates from sports nutrition recommendations, not medical advice.

bmiLow.title: Your weight is below the recommended range
bmiLow.body: Your BMI is around {{bmi}}. Please see a doctor or dietitian to rule out medical causes and plan a safe way to gain weight.

rapidLoss.title: Your weight has been dropping lately
rapidLoss.body: Your weight trend is falling fairly fast while your plan is to gain. If that is not on purpose, please see a doctor. Meanwhile, try to eat regularly up to the kcal target each day.

aboveHealthy.title: Your target is above the healthy weight range
aboveHealthy.body: The target BMI is around {{bmi}}, above the healthy limit of 25. You can still continue. If you want to build muscle, talk to a coach or dietitian so the gain is on track.

coach.scanShort: You still need {{kcal}} kcal today, so this helps.
coach.scanReached: Today's target is already reached. This is a bonus if you are hungry.
coach.dayImpact: Today's total {{total}} of the {{target}} kcal target
coach.dense: If portions feel big, pick calorie-dense food: rice, eggs, tempeh, nuts, avocado, or milk.
coach.strength: Strength training: log exercises, sets, reps, and weight. Rising weights help the extra gain become muscle.

surplusExplainer.title: Why the word surplus?
surplusExplainer.body: A surplus is the extra calories above what your body needs. That gap is what raises your weight. You don't need to calculate it, just eat around your target.

coach.dailyTip: Eating a little, often, is easier than three big meals.

recap.weightDown: Down {{kg}} kg this week. Check whether your meals reached the target.
recap.daysOnTarget: {{on}} of {{total}} days eating up to target

celebrate.great: A strong week: you ate enough almost every day.
celebrate.some: Some progress. Add one nutritious, dense snack to reach the target more often.
celebrate.low: Still often below the target this week. Try setting a dinner reminder.

recap.shareLine: My recap {{name}}: {{on}} of {{logged}} days eating up to target, averaging {{avg}} kcal a day. Gaining with JoyoRogo.

share.gained: Up {{kg}} kg already. Gaining weight with just 3 numbers on JoyoRogo.
share.progress: Gaining weight with just 3 numbers: eat, burn, sleep. JoyoRogo.

group.streak: Ate up to target {{count}} days in a row

reminder.label: Reminder when still short
reminder.hint: Shows in the evening only if you are still under today's calorie target.
reminder.title: {{kcal}} kcal still to go today
reminder.body: A good dinner helps your target. Try adding rice, eggs, or tempeh.
reminder.bodyShort: A good dinner helps your target.

estimate.title: About calorie estimates from photos
estimate.body: Calories from a photo are an estimate and can be off in either direction. When you are gaining, a number that is too high means you ate less than you logged. Watch your weight trend over 2 to 3 weeks, not one day, then adjust portions.

nativeSetup.needGainTarget: To gain weight, set a target above your current weight.
nativeSetup.needLoseTarget: To lose weight, set a target below your current weight.

explain.left: What you still need to eat today to reach your target. Once you are there or past it, there is nothing to chase.

explain.leftBody: What you still need to eat today to reach your target. Once you are there or past it, there is nothing to chase.

recap.streakSub: eating up to target without a break
recap.note: Based on your own logs, not a medical assessment. Up to target means you ate at least 90% of your daily target. Weight uses the trend (a moving average), so it ignores day-to-day scale swings.

chart.detailLegend: Line = trend (7-day moving average), dots = daily weigh-ins. Bars = logged daily calories (dark = reached the target, light = not yet); hatched area = days not logged. Light green area = gentle gain band.
